svg.title: Parlor and the apps behind it
svg.desc: Browser or phone → app.py (HTTPS); TV → app.py (/tv); app.py → Library; app.py → Requests; app.py → Watch and Live; app.py → Games; Library → Jellyfin (plays); Requests → Seerr (asks); Seerr → Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr; Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr → Prowlarr + FlareSolverr; Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr → qBittorrent; Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr → Bazarr; Cleanuparr → qBittorrent; Questarr → Prowlarr + FlareSolverr; Questarr → qBittorrent; qBittorrent → Gluetun; qBittorrent → Media folders (saves); Games → moonlight-web; app.py → YouTube, Twitch, Steam (fetches); Checkrr → Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr (fetch again)
svg.text: Parlor and the apps behind it
the VPN, its only way out
